findings.desc: Metadata filtering in active worktree overlap detection hard-codes broad roots/filenames instead of using the runtime artifact registry. It can hide material files with runtime-like basenames and treats .omx as ignored metadata despite local OMX being disabled, so real overlapping material changes can be missed.

Changed-file probes are collected for all active stories, but failed probe risk is only attached to selected story refs. If a selected story has no overlap while another active story has a broken registered worktree, the selected story can still be recommended parallel_dev with no visible collection-level risk.

The story-worktree smoke claims to cover relative worktree path resolution, but seeded overlap stories store absolute worktree.path values. The new assertion bypasses resolveWorktreePath relative-path behavior and would pass even if relative .worktrees/<id> handling regressed.
